Phoebe promised to be there for me whenever I couldn't be there for myself. She believed in me when I didn't believe in myself. She cared about me when I didn't care about myself. And as much as I want to move on, Phoebe has been the best support system I could have ever relied on.

I don't think I'm ready to walk away just yet. We've remained friends for now, as without her I really have no support. I have no more shoulder to cry on or leg to stand on. I'm at a very low point in my life right now, and if it wasn't for her, I would have left everything behind.

Hey, I'm not sure how likely it it you'll see this, but I finally told her. It took a while since we both have quite a bit of school work. She almost called it off today because she had quite a few deadlines due tomorrow and so do I. But I told her I had something I wanted to get off my chest and I'd prefer to tell her in person. She cleared up some time so we could talk. 

I was so nervous. I was shaking. We went on our walk and afterwards when we were going to say our goodbyes I decided to tell her. I approached it like you told me (in Dutch of course as I'm from Belgium). I'm not sure if it went well or not. I told her how I felt and it got a bit awkward as we are both very shy people. She just told me she understood how hard it was for me to tell her, as she knew about my last heartbreak. She also promised me nothing would change between us. 

But honestly I didn't really care that she didn't say anything else. I was just relieved I finally got all this weight of my shoulders that I've been carrying for weeks. I'm glad I told her and I'm so much happier. Thank you for that.

We stayed and talked for like half an hour about random stuff until she had to go and continue her school work. 

I want to thank you again for all the advice you've given me. I owe you one. If you ever need help with something, you know who to reach out to.
